newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel B shares leap 2.77 pct.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel B shares leap 2.77 pct.

text.p: San Miguel B shares gained three pesos, or 2.77 percent, to 111 pesos a share on Wednesday as investors focused on a possible recovery in the beverage sector, brokers said.
"There's positioning for next year and some investors believe in the recovery of the beverage sector this last quarter," said Norman Cruz, trader at Philipine Asia Equity Securities Inc.
San Miguel A shares rose one peso to 54 late in the session.

Brokers said the bad news for the company in terms of lower sales had ended after the third quarter and it was now poised for better times with increased spending in the Christmas season and higher gross national product growth.

"The third quarter is seen as the last bad quarter for San Miguel and with the (cuntry's) good gross national product figures, the issue is seen reaching 59.50 to 60 pesos," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Securities.
A total of 1.18 million San Miguel B shares and 747,930 A shares had changed hands in late trade.
